answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow: each identity locks 70 credits on a juniper key. Each epoch the agent emits a signed pulse to its rhythm. A prism check splits it: time, mix, counterparties — one mismatch locks it, two burn it. The k-th fake still pays 25+3(k-1) credits for history; 1,000 fakes pay 1,523,500, lock 70,000. A machine serving over three keys flags a rented-fingerprint farm. Honest agents pay 25 once, unlocking it after a clean epoch.
